Record.ACIKLAMA: Dinamo kod arama - tum tanimlari TXT olarak disari aktarir
Record.SCRIPTTEXT:
'============================================================================== ' KOD_ARA_EXPORT - Aktif firmaya ait tum kodlari TXT olarak aktarir ' Hedef: C:\KOD_ARA_KLASORU\dinamo\{MODUL}\{Firma}_{MODUL}.txt ' Parcali kayitlar SRNUM sirasiyla birlestirilir '==============================================================================
Public ExportCount, LogText, FirmCode, RootFolder, SepLine, gColCache, gSqlSeq, KA_MaxAramaSonuc
Sub Makro1 Set KRT = Doc.CreateTableObject("KRITERLER=STACK", "IO") KRT.Addfield2 "MODULSEC", "CHAR", 1, 0, "L", "", "" KRT.Addfield2 "ARA_MODUL", "CHAR", 1, 0, "L", "", "" KRT.Addfield2 "KLASOR", "CHAR", 250, 0, "L", "", "" KRT.Addfield2 "STDHARIC", "CHAR", 1, 0, "L", "", "" KRT.Addfield2 "ARAMA_KELIME", "CHAR", 250, 0, "L", "", "" KRT.Addfield2 "ARAMA_TIP", "CHAR", 1, 0, "L", "", "" KRT.Addfield2 "GENEL_KELIME", "CHAR", 250, 0, "L", "", "" KRT.Addfield2 "GENEL_TABLO", "CHAR", 40, 0, "L", "", "" KRT.Addfield2 "GENEL_TAM", "CHAR", 1, 0, "L", "", "" KRT.MODULSEC = "H" KRT.ARA_MODUL = "H" KRT.STDHARIC = "E" KRT.ARAMA_TIP = "H" KRT.KLASOR = KA_RootFolder() KRT.ARAMA_KELIME = "" KRT.GENEL_KELIME = "" KRT.GENEL_TABLO = "" KRT.GENEL_TAM = "H" Call KA_InitGridTables() Dim Par Set Par = Nothing Doc.LoadSubForm_Dyn "KOD_ARA_FORM", SC_SCRIPTMODULEFILENAME, Par End Sub
Function KA_RootFolder() KA_RootFolder = "C:\KOD_ARA_KLAS" & Chr(214) & "R" & Chr(220) & "\dinamo\" End Function
Sub KA_InitGridTables() Sql = "SELECT '' AS MODUL, '' AS EVRAKNO, '' AS TABLO, '' AS ACIKLAMA, '' AS BOLUM, '' AS OZET FROM MAKR7SE WHERE 1=0" Set T = Doc.RunSqlQuery("KODARA_SONUC", Sql) Sql = "SELECT '' AS TABLO_ADI, '' AS ALAN_ADI, '' AS KAYIT_SAYISI, '' AS ORNEK FROM MAKR7SE WHERE 1=0" Set T = Doc.RunSqlQuery("GENEL_SONUC", Sql) End Sub
Sub KA_AppendGridResult(SON, TblDolu) If TblDolu Is Nothing Then Exit Sub If KA_RowCount(TblDolu) = 0 Then Exit Sub If KA_RowCount(SON) = 0 Then SON.CopyTable(TblDolu) Exit Sub End If On Error Resume Next SON.AppendTable(TblDolu) If Err.Number = 0 Then On Error GoTo 0 Exit Sub End If Err.Clear On Error GoTo 0 For i = 1 To KA_RowCount(TblDolu) R = SON.AddRow SON.SetCurrentRow R SON.MODUL = KA_GetFld(TblDolu, "MODUL", i) SON.EVRAKNO = KA_GetFld(TblDolu, "EVRAKNO", i) SON.TABLO = KA_GetFld(TblDolu, "TABLO", i) SON.ACIKLAMA = KA_GetFld(TblDolu, "ACIKLAMA", i) SON.BOLUM = KA_GetFld(TblDolu, "BOLUM", i) SON.OZET = KA_GetFld(TblDolu, "OZET", i) Next End Sub
Sub cmd_export Set KRT = Doc.GetTableObject("KRITERLER") Call KA_RunExport(KRT) End Sub
Sub cmd_ara Set KRT = Doc.GetTableObject("KRITERLER") Call KA_RunSearch(KRT) End Sub
Sub cmd_genel_ara Set KRT = Doc.GetTableObject("KRITERLER") Call KA_RunGlobalSearch(KRT) End Sub
Sub KA_RunExport(KRT) SepLine = "----------------------------------------------------------------" ExportCount = 0 LogText = "" FirmCode = Trim(Doc.Getd7FirmCode()) If FirmCode = "" Then FirmCode = "FIRMA" RootFolder = Trim(KRT.KLASOR) If RootFolder = "" Then RootFolder = KA_RootFolder() If Right(RootFolder, 1) <> "\" Then RootFolder = RootFolder & "\" Set Fso = CreateObject("Scripting.FileSystemObject") Call KA_EnsureFolder(Fso, RootFolder) ModulVal = UCase(Trim(KRT.MODULSEC)) If ModulVal = "H" Or ModulVal = "M" Then Call KA_ExportMakr7s(Fso, KRT) If ModulVal = "H" Or ModulVal = "F" Then Call KA_ExportPfrm7s(Fso, KRT) If ModulVal = "H" Or ModulVal = "V" Then Call KA_ExportMakr8s(Fso, KRT) If ModulVal = "H" Or ModulVal = "R" Then Call KA_ExportRep17s(Fso, KRT) If ModulVal = "H" Or ModulVal = "E" Then Call KA_ExportEfrm10(Fso, KRT) If ModulVal = "H" Or ModulVal = "K" Then Call KA_ExportRwstdf(Fso, KRT) If ModulVal = "H" Or ModulVal = "U" Then Call KA_ExportUapp10(Fso, KRT) Call KA_WriteTextFile(Fso, RootFolder & "_export_info.txt", "Firma=" & FirmCode & vbCrLf & "Tarih=" & Doc.Bugun() & vbCrLf & LogText) Set Fso = Nothing MsgBox "Kod aktarimi tamamlandi." & vbCrLf & "Firma: " & FirmCode & vbCrLf & "Dosya: " & ExportCount & vbCrLf & RootFolder, vbInformation, "KOD ARA" End Sub
Function KA_SqlQuote(Val) KA_SqlQuote = Replace(Trim(Val), "'", "''") End Function
Sub KA_EnsureFolder(Fso, FolderPath) If Trim(FolderPath) = "" Then Exit Sub If Not Fso.FolderExists(FolderPath) Then Fso.CreateFolder FolderPath End Sub
Function KA_RunSql(QName, Sql) On Error Resume Next gSqlSeq = gSqlSeq + 1 QN = QName & "_" & CStr(gSqlSeq) Set KA_RunSql = Doc.RunSQLQuery(QN, Sql) If KA_RunSql Is Nothing Then Set KA_RunSql = Doc.RunSqlQuery(QN, Sql) On Error GoTo 0 End Function
Function KA_SqlTop(Sql, MaxRows) If MaxRows <= 0 Then KA_SqlTop = Sql Exit Function End If If InStr(1, UCase(Sql), "SELECT TOP", 1) > 0 Then KA_SqlTop = Sql Else KA_SqlTop = Replace(Sql, "SELECT ", "SELECT TOP " & CStr(MaxRows) & " ", 1, 1, 1) End If End Function
Function KA_RowCount(Tbl) KA_RowCount = 0 If Tbl Is Nothing Then Exit Function KA_RowCount = Tbl.GetRecCount() If KA_RowCount = 0 Then KA_RowCount = Tbl.GetRowCount() End Function
Function KA_GetFld(Tbl, Fld, RowNo) On Error Resume Next KA_GetFld = Trim(Tbl.GetFieldValue(Fld, RowNo)) If Err.Number <> 0 Then KA_GetFld = Trim(Tbl.GetFieldValue(UCase(Fld), RowNo)) On Error GoTo 0 End Function
Function KA_StdWhere(KRT, KeyFld) W = "" If Trim(KRT.STDHARIC) = "E" Then W = W & " AND LEFT(" & KeyFld & ",2)<>'++'" KA_StdWhere = W End Function
Function KA_TableHasColumn(TableName, ColName) KA_TableHasColumn = False TN = UCase(Trim(TableName)) CN = UCase(Trim(ColName)) If TN = "" Or CN = "" Then Exit Function Sql = "SELECT COUNT(*) AS CNT FROM INFORMATION_SCHEMA.COLUMNS WHERE TABLE_NAME='" & KA_SqlQuote(TN) & "' AND COLUMN_NAME='" & KA_SqlQuote(CN) & "'" Set rsC = KA_RunSql("ka_col_" & TN & "_" & CN, Sql) If rsC Is Nothing Then Exit Function Cnt = Trim(KA_GetFld(rsC, "CNT", 1)) If Cnt <> "" Then If CDbl(Cnt) > 0 Then KA_TableHasColumn = True End If End Function
Function KA_FilterRowFields(RowTable, FieldList) KA_FilterRowFields = "" Arr = Split(FieldList, ";") For Each F In Arr Fld = Trim(F) If Fld <> "" And KA_TableHasColumn(RowTable, Fld) Then If KA_FilterRowFields <> "" Then KA_FilterRowFields = KA_FilterRowFields & ";" KA_FilterRowFields = KA_FilterRowFields & Fld End If Next End Function
Function KA_CollectChunks(TableName, KeyField, KeyValue, TextField) KA_CollectChunks = "" If Trim(TableName) = "" Or Trim(TextField) = "" Or Trim(KeyValue) = "" Then Exit Function Sql = "SELECT " & TextField & " FROM " & TableName & " WHERE " & KeyField & "='" & KA_SqlQuote(KeyValue) & "' ORDER BY SRNUM" Set rs = KA_RunSql("ka_chk_" & TableName, Sql) If rs Is Nothing Then Exit Function For i = 1 To KA_RowCount(rs) KA_CollectChunks = KA_CollectChunks & KA_GetFld(rs, TextField, i) Next End Function
Function KA_CollectRowsText(TableName, KeyField, KeyValue, TextFields) KA_CollectRowsText = "" If Trim(TableName) = "" Or Trim(KeyValue) = "" Then Exit Function Sql = "SELECT * FROM " & TableName & " WHERE " & KeyField & "='" & KA_SqlQuote(KeyValue) & "' ORDER BY SRNUM" Set rs = KA_RunSql("ka_row_" & TableName, Sql) If rs Is Nothing Then Exit Function Arr = Split(TextFields, ";") For i = 1 To KA_RowCount(rs) For Each F In Arr Fld = Trim(F) If Fld <> "" And KA_TableHasColumn(TableName, Fld) Then V = KA_GetFld(rs, Fld, i) If V <> "" Then KA_CollectRowsText = KA_CollectRowsText & Fld & "=" & V & vbTab End If Next KA_CollectRowsText = KA_CollectRowsText & vbCrLf Next End Function
Sub KA_WriteTextFile(Fso, FilePath, Content) Set T = Fso.CreateTextFile(FilePath, True) T.Write Content T.Close End Sub
Sub KA_AppendTextFile(Fso, FilePath, Content, IsNew) If IsNew Then Set T = Fso.CreateTextFile(FilePath, True) Else Set T = Fso.OpenTextFile(FilePath, 8, True) End If T.Write Content T.Close End Sub
Sub KA_AppendBlock(Fso, FilePath, BlockText, ByRef IsNew) Call KA_AppendTextFile(Fso, FilePath, BlockText & vbCrLf & SepLine & vbCrLf, IsNew) IsNew = False ExportCount = ExportCount + 1 End Sub
Function KA_HeaderBlock(Title, AppName, Kod, Tablo, Ilave, Aciklama) B = Title & vbCrLf B = B & "Firma Kodu : " & FirmCode & " / Uygulama : " & AppName & vbCrLf B = B & "Makro Kodu : " & Trim(Kod) & vbCrLf B = B & "Hangi Tablo icin : " & Trim(Tablo) & vbCrLf B = B & "Ilave Hangi Uygulamalar icin : " & Trim(Ilave) & vbCrLf B = B & "Aciklama : " & Trim(Aciklama) & vbCrLf KA_HeaderBlock = B End Function
Function KA_EkranFormuSablon() KA_EkranFormuSablon = "Ekran Formu" & vbCrLf _ & "Uygulamalar icin Baslangic Ekran Formu Ayarlari" & vbCrLf _ & "Baslangic Ekran Formu Bu Uygulama icin : " & vbCrLf _ & "Bu Uygulama icin Baslangic Ekran Formu : " & vbCrLf _ & "Baslangicta Bu Makro Calisacak : " & vbCrLf _ & "Alt Ekranlar icin Ekran Formu" & vbCrLf _ & "Alt Ekran Form Kodu : " & vbCrLf _ & "Yeni Alt Ekra Form Kodu: " & vbCrLf _ & "Alt Ekran Acilmadan once Calistirilacak Makro : " & vbCrLf End Function
Sub KA_ExportMakr7s(Fso, KRT) ModFolder = RootFolder & "MAKR7S\" Call KA_EnsureFolder(Fso, ModFolder) OutFile = ModFolder & FirmCode & "_MAKR7S.txt" IsNew = True Sql = "SELECT EVRAKNO, DOCTYPE, ADDDOCTYPES, ACIKLAMA FROM MAKR7SE WHERE 1=1" & KA_StdWhere(KRT, "EVRAKNO") & " ORDER BY EVRAKNO" Set Tbl = KA_RunSql("ka_m7_list", Sql) LogText = LogText & "MAKR7S=" & KA_RowCount(Tbl) & vbCrLf For i = 1 To KA_RowCount(Tbl) Evrak = KA_GetFld(Tbl, "EVRAKNO", i) Doc.StatusbarMessage "MAKR7S: " & i & "/" & KA_RowCount(Tbl) & " " & Evrak KodTxt = KA_CollectChunks("MAKR7ST", "EVRAKNO", Evrak, "SCRIPTTEXT_RO") FormTxt = KA_CollectChunks("MAKR7SF", "EVRAKNO", Evrak, "SCRIPTTEXT_RO") AltTxt = KA_CollectChunks("MAKR7SA", "EVRAKNO", Evrak, "SCRIPTTEXT_RO") B = KA_HeaderBlock("Makro Kaynak Kodu", "MAKR7S", Evrak, KA_GetFld(Tbl, "DOCTYPE", i), KA_GetFld(Tbl, "ADDDOCTYPES", i), KA_GetFld(Tbl, "ACIKLAMA", i)) B = B & "Kod : " & vbCrLf & KodTxt & vbCrLf & vbCrLf B = B & KA_EkranFormuSablon() If AltTxt <> "" Then B = B & AltTxt & vbCrLf If FormTxt <> "" Then B = B & FormTxt Call KA_AppendBlock(Fso, OutFile, B, IsNew) Next End Sub
Sub KA_ExportPfrm7s(Fso, KRT) ModFolder = RootFolder & "PFRM7S\" Call KA_EnsureFolder(Fso, ModFolder) OutFile = ModFolder & FirmCode & "_PFRM7S.txt" IsNew = True Sql = "SELECT EVRAKNO, DOCTYPE, ADDDOCTYPES, ACIKLAMA FROM PFRM7SE WHERE 1=1" & KA_StdWhere(KRT, "EVRAKNO") & " ORDER BY EVRAKNO" Set Tbl = KA_RunSql("ka_pf_list", Sql) LogText = LogText & "PFRM7S=" & KA_RowCount(Tbl) & vbCrLf For i = 1 To KA_RowCount(Tbl) Evrak = KA_GetFld(Tbl, "EVRAKNO", i) Doc.StatusbarMessage "PFRM7S: " & i & "/" & KA_RowCount(Tbl) & " " & Evrak KodTxt = KA_CollectChunks("PFRM7ST", "EVRAKNO", Evrak, "SCRIPTTEXT_RO") AltTxt = KA_CollectChunks("PFRM7SA", "EVRAKNO", Evrak, "SCRIPTTEXT_RO") If AltTxt <> "" Then KodTxt = KodTxt & AltTxt B = KA_HeaderBlock("Form Kaynak Kodu", "PFRM7S", Evrak, KA_GetFld(Tbl, "DOCTYPE", i), KA_GetFld(Tbl, "ADDDOCTYPES", i), KA_GetFld(Tbl, "ACIKLAMA", i)) B = B & "Kod : " & vbCrLf & KodTxt Call KA_AppendBlock(Fso, OutFile, B, IsNew) Next End Sub
Sub KA_ExportMakr8s(Fso, KRT) ModFolder = RootFolder & "MAKR8S\" Call KA_EnsureFolder(Fso, ModFolder) OutFile = ModFolder & FirmCode & "_MAKR8S.txt" IsNew = True Sql = "SELECT EVRAKNO, DOCTYPE, ADDDOCTYPES, ATABLENAME, ACIKLAMA FROM MAKR8SE WHERE 1=1" & KA_StdWhere(KRT, "EVRAKNO") & " ORDER BY EVRAKNO" Set Tbl = KA_RunSql("ka_m8_list", Sql) LogText = LogText & "MAKR8S=" & KA_RowCount(Tbl) & vbCrLf For i = 1 To KA_RowCount(Tbl) Evrak = KA_GetFld(Tbl, "EVRAKNO", i) Tablo = KA_GetFld(Tbl, "ATABLENAME", i) If Tablo = "" Then Tablo = KA_GetFld(Tbl, "DOCTYPE", i) Doc.StatusbarMessage "MAKR8S: " & i & "/" & KA_RowCount(Tbl) & " " & Evrak KodTxt = KA_CollectChunks("MAKR8ST", "EVRAKNO", Evrak, "SCRIPTTEXT_RO") AltTxt = KA_CollectChunks("MAKR8SA", "EVRAKNO", Evrak, "SCRIPTTEXT_RO") If AltTxt <> "" Then KodTxt = KodTxt & AltTxt B = KA_HeaderBlock("Makro Kaynak Kodu", "MAKR8S", Evrak, Tablo, KA_GetFld(Tbl, "ADDDOCTYPES", i), KA_GetFld(Tbl, "ACIKLAMA", i)) B = B & "Kod : " & vbCrLf & KodTxt Call KA_AppendBlock(Fso, OutFile, B, IsNew) Next End Sub
Sub KA_ExportRep17s(Fso, KRT) ModFolder = RootFolder & "REP17S\" Call KA_EnsureFolder(Fso, ModFolder) OutFile = ModFolder & FirmCode & "_REP17S.txt" IsNew = True Sql = "SELECT EVRAKNO, AU_TABLE, ACIKLAMA FROM REP17SE WHERE 1=1" & KA_StdWhere(KRT, "EVRAKNO") & " ORDER BY EVRAKNO" Set Tbl = KA_RunSql("ka_rp_list", Sql) LogText = LogText & "REP17S=" & KA_RowCount(Tbl) & vbCrLf For i = 1 To KA_RowCount(Tbl) Evrak = KA_GetFld(Tbl, "EVRAKNO", i) Doc.StatusbarMessage "REP17S: " & i & "/" & KA_RowCount(Tbl) & " " & Evrak ProcTxt = KA_CollectChunks("REP17AT", "EVRAKNO", Evrak, "ACIKLAMATEXT_RO") SqlTxt = KA_CollectChunks("REP17QT", "EVRAKNO", Evrak, "SQLTEXT_RO") FormTxt = KA_CollectChunks("REP17FT", "EVRAKNO", Evrak, "FORMTEXT_RO") CalcTxt = KA_CollectChunks("REP17ST", "EVRAKNO", Evrak, "SCRIPTTEXT_RO") KritTxt = KA_CollectRowsText("REP17KT", "EVRAKNO", Evrak, "FIELDNAME1;KRITERTIPI;SORUACIKLAMA;ARASTIRFORMULU;DEFVALUE01;DEFVALUE02") JoinTxt = KA_CollectRowsText("REP17JT", "EVRAKNO", Evrak, "FIELDNAME1;JOINEDTABLE;JOINEDFIELD;RESULTFIELD") UtTxt = KA_CollectRowsText("REP17UT", "EVRAKNO", Evrak, "FIELDNAME1;HESAPLAMA_SCRIPT;ARASTIRFORMULU;ACIKLAMA") B = "Rapor Kaynak Kodu" & vbCrLf B = B & "Firma Kodu : " & FirmCode & " / Uygulama : REP17S" & vbCrLf B = B & "Makro Kodu : " & Trim(Evrak) & vbCrLf B = B & "Hangi Tablo icin : " & KA_GetFld(Tbl, "AU_TABLE", i) & vbCrLf B = B & "Aciklama : " & KA_GetFld(Tbl, "ACIKLAMA", i) & vbCrLf B = B & "Prosedur Sekmesi : " & vbCrLf & vbCrLf & ProcTxt & vbCrLf & vbCrLf B = B & "SQL Komutu Sekmesi" & vbCrLf & vbCrLf & SqlTxt & vbCrLf & vbCrLf B = B & "Kriter Tanimlari Sekmesi" & vbCrLf & vbCrLf & KritTxt & vbCrLf & vbCrLf B = B & "Baglantili Tablolar Sekmesi" & vbCrLf & vbCrLf & JoinTxt & vbCrLf & vbCrLf B = B & "Ekran Formu Sekmesi" & vbCrLf & vbCrLf & FormTxt & vbCrLf & vbCrLf B = B & "Eklenen Alanlar - Hesaplamalar Sekmesi" & vbCrLf & vbCrLf & CalcTxt If UtTxt <> "" Then B = B & vbCrLf & UtTxt Call KA_AppendBlock(Fso, OutFile, B, IsNew) Next End Sub
Sub KA_ExportEfrm10(Fso, KRT) ModFolder = RootFolder & "EFRM10\" Call KA_EnsureFolder(Fso, ModFolder) OutFile = ModFolder & FirmCode & "_EFRM10.txt" IsNew = True Sql = "SELECT EVRAKNO, DOCTYPE, ADDDOCTYPES, ACIKLAMA FROM EFRM10E WHERE 1=1" & KA_StdWhere(KRT, "EVRAKNO") & " ORDER BY EVRAKNO" Set Tbl = KA_RunSql("ka_ef_list", Sql) LogText = LogText & "EFRM10=" & KA_RowCount(Tbl) & vbCrLf For i = 1 To KA_RowCount(Tbl) Evrak = KA_GetFld(Tbl, "EVRAKNO", i) Doc.StatusbarMessage "EFRM10: " & i & "/" & KA_RowCount(Tbl) & " " & Evrak FormTxt = KA_CollectChunks("EFRM10T", "EVRAKNO", Evrak, "SCRIPTTEXT_RO") KodTxt = KA_CollectChunks("EFRM10TM", "EVRAKNO", Evrak, "SCRIPTTEXT_RO") AltTxt = KA_CollectChunks("EFRM10A", "EVRAKNO", Evrak, "SCRIPTTEXT_RO") T2Txt = KA_CollectRowsText("EFRM10T2", "EVRAKNO", Evrak, "FORMKODU;TABNAME_1;KULLANICIKODU;FORM_OPT") B = KA_HeaderBlock("Ekranli Makro Kaynak Kodu", "EFRM10", Evrak, KA_GetFld(Tbl, "DOCTYPE", i), KA_GetFld(Tbl, "ADDDOCTYPES", i), KA_GetFld(Tbl, "ACIKLAMA", i)) B = B & "Ekran Formu Sekmesi : " & vbCrLf & vbCrLf & FormTxt & vbCrLf & vbCrLf B = B & "Makro Kodu Sekmesi : " & vbCrLf & vbCrLf & KodTxt If AltTxt <> "" Then B = B & vbCrLf & AltTxt If T2Txt <> "" Then B = B & vbCrLf & "Ekran Ayarlari :" & vbCrLf & T2Txt Call KA_AppendBlock(Fso, OutFile, B, IsNew) Next End Sub
Sub KA_ExportRwstdf(Fso, KRT) ModFolder = RootFolder & "RWSTDF\" Call KA_EnsureFolder(Fso, ModFolder) OutFile = ModFolder & FirmCode & "_RWSTDF.txt" IsNew = True Sql = "SELECT ITEMCODE, ITEMNAME, BK_ACIKLAMA, MAIN_TABLE, FILTERING_TABLE FROM RWSTDFE WHERE 1=1" & KA_StdWhere(KRT, "ITEMCODE") & " ORDER BY ITEMCODE" Set Tbl = KA_RunSql("ka_rw_list", Sql) LogText = LogText & "RWSTDF=" & KA_RowCount(Tbl) & vbCrLf For i = 1 To KA_RowCount(Tbl) Item = KA_GetFld(Tbl, "ITEMCODE", i) Doc.StatusbarMessage "RWSTDF: " & i & "/" & KA_RowCount(Tbl) & " " & Item ProcTxt = KA_CollectChunks("RWSTDFETB", "ITEMCODE", Item, "PTEXT1_RO") ColTxt = KA_CollectRowsText("RWSTDFT", "ITEMCODE", Item, "COLUMN_NAME;FW_DATA_TYPE;LABEL1;BROWSE_FNC;DEFAULT_VALUE_1") UpdTxt = KA_CollectRowsText("RWSTDFTU", "ITEMCODE", Item, "DB_ISLEM_TURU;COLUMNS;COLUMNS_VALUE;COLUMNS_CRITERIA;NOTE1") B = "KTT Kaynak Kodu" & vbCrLf B = B & "Firma Kodu : " & FirmCode & " / Uygulama : RWSTDF" & vbCrLf B = B & "Makro Kodu : " & Trim(Item) & vbCrLf B = B & "Hangi Tablo icin : " & KA_GetFld(Tbl, "MAIN_TABLE", i) & vbCrLf B = B & "Filtre Tablosu : " & KA_GetFld(Tbl, "FILTERING_TABLE", i) & vbCrLf B = B & "Aciklama : " & KA_GetFld(Tbl, "BK_ACIKLAMA", i) & vbCrLf B = B & "Tablo Adi : " & KA_GetFld(Tbl, "ITEMNAME", i) & vbCrLf B = B & "Prosedur / Kod : " & vbCrLf & vbCrLf & ProcTxt & vbCrLf & vbCrLf B = B & "Kolon Tanimlari : " & vbCrLf & ColTxt & vbCrLf B = B & "Guncelleme Tanimlari : " & vbCrLf & UpdTxt Call KA_AppendBlock(Fso, OutFile, B, IsNew) Next End Sub
Sub KA_ExportUapp10(Fso, KRT) ModFolder = RootFolder & "UAPP10\" Call KA_EnsureFolder(Fso, ModFolder) OutFile = ModFolder & FirmCode & "_UAPP10.txt" IsNew = True Sql = "SELECT EVRAKNO, ACIKLAMA FROM UAPP10E WHERE 1=1" & KA_StdWhere(KRT, "EVRAKNO") & " ORDER BY EVRAKNO" Set Tbl = KA_RunSql("ka_ua_list", Sql) LogText = LogText & "UAPP10=" & KA_RowCount(Tbl) & vbCrLf For i = 1 To KA_RowCount(Tbl) Evrak = KA_GetFld(Tbl, "EVRAKNO", i) Doc.StatusbarMessage "UAPP10: " & i & "/" & KA_RowCount(Tbl) & " " & Evrak FormTxt = KA_CollectChunks("UAPP10T", "EVRAKNO", Evrak, "SCRIPTTEXT_RO") KodTxt = KA_CollectChunks("UAPP10TM", "EVRAKNO", Evrak, "SCRIPTTEXT_RO") AltTxt = KA_CollectChunks("UAPP10A", "EVRAKNO", Evrak, "SCRIPTTEXT_RO") DetTxt = KA_CollectChunks("UAPP10D", "EVRAKNO", Evrak, "SCRIPTTEXT_RO") T2Txt = KA_CollectRowsText("UAPP10T2", "EVRAKNO", Evrak, "ROWSET_NAME_1;DBDEF0_KOD;DBDEF0_TABLE_NAME;DBDEF0_CATALOG;DBDEF0_SCHEMA") B = KA_HeaderBlock("KTM Kaynak Kodu", "UAPP10", Evrak, "", "", KA_GetFld(Tbl, "ACIKLAMA", i)) B = B & "Ekran Formu Sekmesi : " & vbCrLf & vbCrLf & FormTxt & vbCrLf & vbCrLf B = B & "Makro Kodu Sekmesi : " & vbCrLf & vbCrLf & KodTxt If AltTxt <> "" Then B = B & vbCrLf & AltTxt If DetTxt <> "" Then B = B & vbCrLf & DetTxt If T2Txt <> "" Then B = B & vbCrLf & "Ekran Ayarlari :" & vbCrLf & T2Txt Call KA_AppendBlock(Fso, OutFile, B, IsNew) Next End Sub
Function KA_LikePat(Val) KA_LikePat = "%" & Replace(Replace(KA_SqlQuote(Val), "[", "[[]"), "%", "[%]") & "%" End Function
Function KA_SqlLikeCI(FieldExpr, Word) W = Trim(Word) If W = "" Then KA_SqlLikeCI = "(" & FieldExpr & " LIKE '%')" Exit Function End If Cond = FieldExpr & " LIKE '" & KA_LikePat(W) & "'" If UCase(W) <> W Then Cond = Cond & " OR " & FieldExpr & " LIKE '" & KA_LikePat(UCase(W)) & "'" If LCase(W) <> W Then Cond = Cond & " OR " & FieldExpr & " LIKE '" & KA_LikePat(LCase(W)) & "'" If Len(W) > 1 Then Wmix = UCase(Left(W, 1)) & LCase(Mid(W, 2)) If Wmix <> W Then Cond = Cond & " OR " & FieldExpr & " LIKE '" & KA_LikePat(Wmix) & "'" End If KA_SqlLikeCI = "(" & Cond & ")" End Function
Function KA_SqlEqCI(FieldExpr, Val) W = Trim(Val) Cond = FieldExpr & "='" & KA_SqlQuote(W) & "'" If UCase(W) <> W Then Cond = Cond & " OR " & FieldExpr & "='" & KA_SqlQuote(UCase(W)) & "'" If LCase(W) <> W Then Cond = Cond & " OR " & FieldExpr & "='" & KA_SqlQuote(LCase(W)) & "'" If Len(W) > 1 Then Wmix = UCase(Left(W, 1)) & LCase(Mid(W, 2)) If Wmix <> W Then Cond = Cond & " OR " & FieldExpr & "='" & KA_SqlQuote(Wmix) & "'" End If KA_SqlEqCI = "(" & Cond & ")" End Function
Function KA_SplitWords(Kelime) KA_SplitWords = Array() If Trim(Kelime) = "" Then Exit Function Raw = Split(Replace(Replace(Trim(Kelime), Chr(9), " "), ",", " "), " ") Wc = 0 For Each P In Raw W = Trim(P) If W <> "" Then Wc = Wc + 1 ReDim Preserve Arr(Wc - 1) Arr(Wc - 1) = W End If Next If Wc > 0 Then KA_SplitWords = Arr End Function
Function KA_WordInChunks(KeyRef, KeyField, ChunkList, TextField, Word) Cond = "" If Trim(ChunkList) = "" Then KA_WordInChunks = "(1=0)" Exit Function End If Arr = Split(ChunkList, ",") For Each Tbl In Arr Tn = Trim(Tbl) If Tn <> "" Then If Cond <> "" Then Cond = Cond & " OR " Cond = Cond & "EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM " & Tn & " c WHERE c." & KeyField & "=" & KeyRef & " AND " & KA_SqlLikeCI("c." & TextField, Word) & ")" End If Next If Cond = "" Then KA_WordInChunks = "(1=0)" Else KA_WordInChunks = "(" & Cond & ")" End If End Function
Function KA_WordInRowFields(KeyRef, KeyField, RowTable, FieldList, Word) FieldList = KA_FilterRowFields(RowTable, FieldList) Cond = "" Arr = Split(FieldList, ";") For Each F In Arr Fld = Trim(F) If Fld <> "" Then If Cond <> "" Then Cond = Cond & " OR " Cond = Cond & KA_SqlLikeCI("r." & Fld, Word) End If Next If Cond = "" Then KA_WordInRowFields = "(1=0)" Else KA_WordInRowFields = "EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM " & RowTable & " r WHERE r." & KeyField & "=" & KeyRef & " AND (" & Cond & "))" End If End Function
Function KA_WordInHeader(HeaderPrefix, HeaderFields, Word) Cond = "" Arr = Split(HeaderFields, ";") For Each F In Arr Fld = Trim(F) If Fld <> "" Then If Cond <> "" Then Cond = Cond & " OR " Cond = Cond & KA_SqlLikeCI(HeaderPrefix & "." & Fld, Word) End If Next If Cond = "" Then KA_WordInHeader = "(1=0)" Else KA_WordInHeader = "(" & Cond & ")" End If End Function
Function KA_WordMatchExpr(KeyRef, KeyField, HeaderPrefix, HeaderFields, ChunkList, TextField, RowSpecs, Word) Expr = KA_WordInChunks(KeyRef, KeyField, ChunkList, TextField, Word) Expr = Expr & " OR " & KA_WordInHeader(HeaderPrefix, HeaderFields, Word) Arr = Split(RowSpecs, "|") For Each Spec In Arr S = Trim(Spec) If S <> "" Then P = InStr(S, "/") If P > 0 Then RowTable = Left(S, P - 1) RowFields = Mid(S, P + 1) Expr = Expr & " OR " & KA_WordInRowFields(KeyRef, KeyField, RowTable, RowFields, Word) End If End If Next KA_WordMatchExpr = "(" & Expr & ")" End Function
Function KA_BuildSearchWhere(KeyRef, KeyField, HeaderPrefix, HeaderFields, ChunkList, TextField, RowSpecs, Words, AndMode) KA_BuildSearchWhere = "" If IsEmpty(Words) Then Exit Function On Error Resume Next Wc = UBound(Words) On Error GoTo 0 If Wc < 0 Then Exit Function Cond = "" For i = 0 To Wc Part = KA_WordMatchExpr(KeyRef, KeyField, HeaderPrefix, HeaderFields, ChunkList, TextField, RowSpecs, Words(i)) If Cond = "" Then Cond = Part ElseIf AndMode Then Cond = Cond & " AND " & Part Else Cond = Cond & " OR " & Part End If Next If Cond <> "" Then KA_BuildSearchWhere = " AND (" & Cond & ")" End Function
Function KA_ChunkHasWord(TableName, KeyField, KeyValue, TextField, Word) KA_ChunkHasWord = False If Trim(Word) = "" Then Exit Function Sql = "SELECT TOP 1 1 AS X FROM " & TableName & " WHERE " & KeyField & "='" & KA_SqlQuote(KeyValue) & "' AND " & KA_SqlLikeCI(TextField, Word) Set rs = KA_RunSql("ka_hit_" & TableName, Sql) If Not rs Is Nothing Then If KA_RowCount(rs) > 0 Then KA_ChunkHasWord = True End If End Function
Function KA_RowHasWord(TableName, KeyField, KeyValue, FieldList, Word) KA_RowHasWord = False FieldList = KA_FilterRowFields(TableName, FieldList) Cond = "" Arr = Split(FieldList, ";") For Each F In Arr Fld = Trim(F) If Fld <> "" Then If Cond <> "" Then Cond = Cond & " OR " Cond = Cond & KA_SqlLikeCI(Fld, Word) End If Next If Cond = "" Then Exit Function Sql = "SELECT TOP 1 1 AS X FROM " & TableName & " WHERE " & KeyField & "='" & KA_SqlQuote(KeyValue) & "' AND (" & Cond & ")" Set rs = KA_RunSql("ka_rhit_" & TableName, Sql) If Not rs Is Nothing Then If KA_RowCount(rs) > 0 Then KA_RowHasWord = True End If End Function
Function KA_HeaderHasWord(Tbl, RowNo, HeaderFields, Word) KA_HeaderHasWord = False Arr = Split(HeaderFields, ";") For Each F In Arr Fld = Trim(F) If Fld <> "" Then V = UCase(KA_GetFld(Tbl, Fld, RowNo)) If InStr(1, V, UCase(Word), 1) > 0 Then KA_HeaderHasWord = True Exit Function End If End If Next End Function
Function KA_FindBolum(KeyField, KeyValue, ChunkList, TextField, RowSpecs, HeaderTbl, HeaderRow, HeaderFields, Words) KA_FindBolum = "" Arr = Split(ChunkList, ",") For Each Tbl In Arr Tn = Trim(Tbl) If Tn <> "" Then For Each W In Words If KA_ChunkHasWord(Tn, KeyField, KeyValue, TextField, W) Then KA_FindBolum = Tn Exit Function End If Next End If Next Specs = Split(RowSpecs, "|") For Each Spec In Specs S = Trim(Spec) If S <> "" Then P = InStr(S, "/") If P > 0 Then RowTable = Left(S, P - 1) RowFields = Mid(S, P + 1) For Each W In Words If KA_RowHasWord(RowTable, KeyField, KeyValue, RowFields, W) Then KA_FindBolum = RowTable Exit Function End If Next End If End If Next If Not HeaderTbl Is Nothing Then For Each W In Words If KA_HeaderHasWord(HeaderTbl, HeaderRow, HeaderFields, W) Then KA_FindBolum = "BASLIK" Exit Function End If Next End If KA_FindBolum = "KOD" End Function
Function KA_MakeSnippet(KeyField, KeyValue, ChunkList, TextField, Words) KA_MakeSnippet = "" Arr = Split(ChunkList, ",") For Each Tbl In Arr Tn = Trim(Tbl) If Tn <> "" Then Txt = KA_CollectChunks(Tn, KeyField, KeyValue, TextField) If Txt <> "" Then UTxt = UCase(Txt) Pos = 0 For Each W In Words P = InStr(1, UTxt, UCase(W), 1) If P > 0 Then If P > Pos Or Pos = 0 Then Pos = P End If Next If Pos > 0 Then S = Pos - 60 If S < 1 Then S = 1 KA_MakeSnippet = Replace(Replace(Mid(Txt, S, 220), vbCrLf, " "), vbLf, " ") Exit Function End If End If End If Next End Function
Sub KA_SearchList(KRT, SON, Modul, Sql, KeyField, ChunkList, TextField, RowSpecs, HeaderFields, Words) If KA_RowCount(SON) >= KA_MaxAramaSonuc Then Exit Sub Sql = KA_SqlTop(Sql, KA_MaxAramaSonuc - KA_RowCount(SON)) On Error Resume Next Err.Clear Set TblDolu = KA_RunSql("ka_dolu_" & Modul, Sql) If Err.Number <> 0 Or TblDolu Is Nothing Then Err.Clear On Error GoTo 0 Exit Sub End If If KA_RowCount(TblDolu) = 0 Then On Error GoTo 0 Exit Sub End If If KA_RowCount(SON) = 0 Then SON.CopyTable(TblDolu) Else SON.AppendTable(TblDolu) If Err.Number <> 0 Then Err.Clear Call KA_AppendGridResult(SON, TblDolu) End If End If On Error GoTo 0 End Sub

Function KA_WordInChunkSpecs(KeyRef, KeyField, SpecList, Word) Cond = "" Arr = Split(SpecList, ",") For Each Spec In Arr S = Trim(Spec) If S <> "" Then P = InStr(S, "/") If P > 0 Then Tbl = Left(S, P - 1) Fld = Mid(S, P + 1) If KA_TableHasColumn(Tbl, Fld) Then If Cond <> "" Then Cond = Cond & " OR " Cond = Cond & "EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM " & Tbl & " c WHERE c." & KeyField & "=" & KeyRef & " AND " & KA_SqlLikeCI("c." & Fld, Word) & ")" End If End If End If Next If Cond = "" Then KA_WordInChunkSpecs = "(1=0)" Else KA_WordInChunkSpecs = "(" & Cond & ")" End If End Function
Function KA_WordMatchExprSpec(KeyRef, KeyField, HeaderPrefix, HeaderFields, ChunkSpecList, RowSpecs, Word) If ChunkSpecList <> "" Then Expr = KA_WordInChunkSpecs(KeyRef, KeyField, ChunkSpecList, Word) Else Expr = "(1=0)" End If Expr = Expr & " OR " & KA_WordInHeader(HeaderPrefix, HeaderFields, Word) Arr = Split(RowSpecs, "|") For Each Spec In Arr S = Trim(Spec) If S <> "" Then P = InStr(S, "/") If P > 0 Then RowTable = Left(S, P - 1) RowFields = Mid(S, P + 1) Expr = Expr & " OR " & KA_WordInRowFields(KeyRef, KeyField, RowTable, RowFields, Word) End If End If Next KA_WordMatchExprSpec = "(" & Expr & ")" End Function
Function KA_BuildSearchWhereSpec(KeyRef, KeyField, HeaderPrefix, HeaderFields, ChunkSpecList, RowSpecs, Words, AndMode) KA_BuildSearchWhereSpec = "" On Error Resume Next Wc = UBound(Words) On Error GoTo 0 If Wc < 0 Then Exit Function Cond = "" For i = 0 To Wc Part = KA_WordMatchExprSpec(KeyRef, KeyField, HeaderPrefix, HeaderFields, ChunkSpecList, RowSpecs, Words(i)) If Cond = "" Then Cond = Part ElseIf AndMode Then Cond = Cond & " AND " & Part Else Cond = Cond & " OR " & Part End If Next If Cond <> "" Then KA_BuildSearchWhereSpec = " AND (" & Cond & ")" End Function
Function KA_GlobalCountSql(TableName, ColumnName, Kelime, TamEslesme) If TamEslesme Then KA_GlobalCountSql = "SELECT COUNT(*) AS CNT FROM " & TableName & " WHERE " & KA_SqlEqCI(ColumnName, Kelime) Else KA_GlobalCountSql = "SELECT COUNT(*) AS CNT FROM " & TableName & " WHERE " & KA_SqlLikeCI(ColumnName, Kelime) End If End Function
Function KA_GlobalSampleSql(TableName, ColumnName, Kelime, TamEslesme) If TamEslesme Then KA_GlobalSampleSql = "SELECT TOP 1 " & ColumnName & " AS DEGER FROM " & TableName & " WHERE " & KA_SqlEqCI(ColumnName, Kelime) Else KA_GlobalSampleSql = "SELECT TOP 1 " & ColumnName & " AS DEGER FROM " & TableName & " WHERE " & KA_SqlLikeCI(ColumnName, Kelime) End If End Function
Function KA_SafeNbr(Val) On Error Resume Next KA_SafeNbr = 0 If Trim(CStr(Val)) <> "" Then KA_SafeNbr = CDbl(Val) On Error GoTo 0 End Function
Sub KA_RunGlobalSearch(KRT) Kelime = Trim(KRT.GENEL_KELIME) If Kelime = "" Then MsgBox "Aranacak kelime veya stok kodu girin.", vbInformation, "KODAKTAR" Exit Sub End If TabloMask = Trim(KRT.GENEL_TABLO) If TabloMask <> "" Then TabloMask = Replace(TabloMask, "*", "%") TamEslesme = (UCase(Trim(KRT.GENEL_TAM)) = "E") Sql = "SELECT c.TABLE_NAME, c.COLUMN_NAME FROM INFORMATION_SCHEMA.COLUMNS c " Sql = Sql & "INNER JOIN INFORMATION_SCHEMA.TABLES t ON t.TABLE_NAME=c.TABLE_NAME AND t.TABLE_TYPE='BASE TABLE' " Sql = Sql & "WHERE c.DATA_TYPE IN ('varchar','char','nvarchar','nchar','text') " If TabloMask <> "" Then Sql = Sql & "AND c.TABLE_NAME LIKE '" & KA_SqlQuote(TabloMask) & "' " Sql = Sql & "ORDER BY c.TABLE_NAME, c.COLUMN_NAME" Set Cols = KA_RunSql("ka_gcols", Sql) If Cols Is Nothing Then MsgBox "Kolon listesi okunamadi.", vbExclamation, "KODAKTAR" Exit Sub End If Set GSON = Doc.GetTableObject("GENEL_SONUC") GSON.Empty Total = KA_RowCount(Cols) Bulunan = 0 For i = 1 To Total Tn = KA_GetFld(Cols, "TABLE_NAME", i) Cn = KA_GetFld(Cols, "COLUMN_NAME", i) Doc.StatusbarMessage "Genel arama: " & i & "/" & Total & " " & Tn & "." & Cn On Error Resume Next Err.Clear Set rsC = KA_RunSql("ka_gc_" & i, KA_GlobalCountSql(Tn, Cn, Kelime, TamEslesme)) If Err.Number = 0 And Not rsC Is Nothing Then Cnt = KA_SafeNbr(KA_GetFld(rsC, "CNT", 1)) If Cnt > 0 Then Ornek = "" Set rsS = KA_RunSql("ka_gs_" & i, KA_GlobalSampleSql(Tn, Cn, Kelime, TamEslesme)) If Not rsS Is Nothing Then Ornek = Left(Trim(KA_GetFld(rsS, "DEGER", 1)), 100) R = GSON.AddRow GSON.SetCurrentRow R GSON.TABLO_ADI = Tn GSON.ALAN_ADI = Cn GSON.KAYIT_SAYISI = CStr(Cnt) GSON.ORNEK = Left(Ornek, 100) Bulunan = Bulunan + 1 End If End If Err.Clear On Error GoTo 0 Next GSON.Refresh If KA_RowCount(GSON) > 0 Then GSON.SetCurrentRow 1 Doc.Frame_Refresh_Controls MsgBox Bulunan & " tablo/alan eslesmesi bulundu." & vbCrLf & "Taranan alan: " & Total, vbInformation, "KODAKTAR" End Sub
